user.title: NFC-Musikbox
user.description: Sets up the NFC music box. Add readers afterwards via “Add reader”.

abort.single_instance_allowed: The NFC music box is already set up.

user.title: Add reader
user.description: Select the ESPHome reader and the speaker that belongs to it.

error.already_configured: This reader is already set up.
error.no_card_sensor: The device has no “Karte auf dem Reader” sensor. Is firmware v3 installed?

init.title: Timing and tolerances
init.description: Fine tuning for card change, resume (Sonos) and the back button.

data_description.removal_rewind: The reader reports “removed” only after a 2 s debounce. The stored position is rewound by this value.
data_description.card_change_delay: Delay between saving the old card and starting the new one.

assign_card.name: Assign card
assign_card.description: Assigns media to an NFC card or changes the assignment.

tag_id.name: Tag ID
tag_id.description: Card ID, e.g. CA-09-0C-05 (see sensor “Current card”).

media.name: Media
media.description: Album, playlist, favorite or radio station.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Audiobook: plays only while the card is on the reader, position is remembered. Music: card starts playback, with its own shuffle and repeat settings.

readers.name: Readers
readers.description: Only on these readers; empty = all.

shuffle.name: Shuffle
shuffle.description: Music mode only. Leave empty = do not change the speaker setting.

repeat.name: Repeat
repeat.description: Music mode only. Leave empty = do not change the speaker setting.

remove_card.name: Remove assignment
remove_card.description: Removes media and remembered position of a card.

reset_position.name: Reset remembered position
reset_position.description: The media starts from the beginning next time.

play_card.name: Test card
play_card.description: Plays a card's media on a reader's speaker without the card on the reader.

resume.name: Resume
resume.description: Resume at the remembered position (like placing the card) instead of from the start.

not_loaded.message: The NFC music box is not set up.

unknown_reader.message: Device {device} is not an NFC music box reader.

no_reader.message: No matching reader for this card.
